description: Sets the final selection set of a native or custom select-like control.

pageId.description: Page ID containing the select control.

selector.description: Unique CSS selector for one select control.

nativeValues.description: Exact native <select> option values. Only for native HTML select controls.

optionIds.description: Current-window option IDs. Only for custom select popups.

optionLabels.description: Exact current-window option labels. Only for custom select popups.

purpose.description: Provide exactly one selection field: nativeValues for a native HTML select, or optionIds/optionLabels for options in the currently open custom popup. Do not combine the fields. After search, scrolling, or pagination, call DOM.inspectSelect or DOM.getSemanticTree again and use only the newly returned options.

controlId.description: Current canonical ID of the select control.

controlKind.description: Whether the control is a native HTML select or a custom popup.

selectionMode.description: Whether one or multiple options may be selected.

id.description: Current option ID when the option is represented in the popup tree.

label.description: Visible option label observed after selection.

value.description: Native option value observed after selection.

selected.description: Options confirmed as selected after the action.

proof.description: Observation used to confirm the final selection state.

resolutionSource.description: Resolution route used for the select control.

recoveredTarget.description: Snapshot details used when a stale target was recovered.

observation.description: Factual observation of the completed Action and its current visible result.

suggested_prompt.description: Action-specific next-step guidance based on the returned result.
